intro.zh: 本次新增应用内更新公告，并包含最近的稳定性与规则改进。
intro.en: This release adds in-app update notes and includes recent stability and rule improvements.

items.zh: 新增应用内更新公告：升级后首次展示，也可随时在设置的更新区域重看。
items.en: New in-app update notes appear the first time after an upgrade and can be revisited anytime in Settings under Updates.

items.zh: 修复一种已确认的 Windows 切换或关闭窗口时闪退的问题。
items.en: Fixed one confirmed Windows crash that could occur when switching or closing windows.

items.zh: 减少 Windows 静止气泡的重复绘制，让陪伴更轻盈。
items.en: Reduced repeated drawing of stationary bubbles on Windows for a lighter experience.

items.zh: 改善内置规则的分类与英文匹配词，并保留完整的规则说明。
items.en: Improved built-in rule categories and English matching terms while preserving complete rule descriptions.
